subject.title: fix(codex): clean final/yield turn close writes a false "user interrupted" marker into the thread rollout

question: Should explicit Codex `final:true` and `sessions_yield` replies wait up to 10 seconds for natural completion, while a newly inbound user message immediately uses the attributed interrupt fallback?
rationale: The implementation changes established terminal timing and the treatment of post-final work; tests can verify mechanics but cannot choose the intended user-facing grace-window policy.

options.title: Adopt the proposed bounded grace window
options.body: Use natural completion after terminal delivery, with a fixed 10-second fallback and immediate interrupt for new inbound user input.

options.title: Keep immediate interruption
options.body: Retain current prompt terminal bookkeeping and accept Codex’s interruption marker and immediate cancellation of post-final work.

options.title: Choose different fallback semantics
options.body: Set a different bounded deadline or inbound-message policy before asking the contributor to reshape the narrow lifecycle seam.

recommendation.title: Adopt the proposed bounded grace window
recommendation.body: Use natural completion after terminal delivery, with a fixed 10-second fallback and immediate interrupt for new inbound user input.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Codex finalization work established the adjacent authoritative terminal-outcome ownership boundary.
